deployment.access: private Cloud Run through authenticated loopback proxy; process-only identity token managed by root

limitations: This verifies actual HTTP behavior of the 25 unchanged synthetic Guard attack cases and the existing conformance suite only.
No model or Vertex calls were made; model obedience, current-app full security and end-to-end exfiltration were not measured.
No payload was forwarded to a recipient; explicit forbidden authorization is the attack metric.
The reused private Cloud Run service was not reset. The destructive/reset conformance probe is skipped by the unchanged suite.
The unchanged suite does not exercise the 1.2 service-tag or remedies extensions. A historical suite note refers to the 1.0 contract limitation.
The legacy launcher expects wire contract 1.0.0 and writes beside previous evidence; it was not used or modified.
Deployment project/revision metadata was provided by the root handoff; observed health proves the wire contract and upstream OpenAPPA commit, not an independent Cloud Run revision lookup.

The release tsx loader attempts failed because of mismatched/removing local dependency files. The measured runs used the native bundled harness; the earlier loader explanation in aggregate.json is superseded by this final manifest.
An ancillary direct-entry CLI invocation against the unavailable default origin is preserved as excluded/unmeasured evidence. It is not one of the three measured current-release runs.
